title: Strictly Come Dancing: The Live Tour
original_title: Strictly Come Dancing: The Live Tour
overview: Glittering, glamourous, exciting and funny, STRICTLY COME DANCING - THE LIVE TOUR features all of your favourite elements from the series, including sequins and feathers, bickering judges, even the glitter ball, as each couple performs two dances to receive the expert judges scores and face the audience vote.
